name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: This task marks the completion of the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine in Ashenvale. With the sacred artifact assembled, it must be returned immediately to the dryad Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary.

sections.title: A Restored Relic
sections.body: The arduous effort to assemble the Rod of Transformation reaches a quiet turning point at the secluded shrine hidden deep within Ashenvale's wilds. Piecing together the shaft, pommel, and glowing gem, and re-enchanting the reconstructed rod at the hidden shrine has restored its magic. The artifact is ready to be returned to Shael'dryn for Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks.

sections.title: Return to Shael'dryn
sections.body: With the assembly complete, word and relic must be delivered swiftly back to Shael'dryn. Stationed beside the calm waters of the forest moonwell, the dryad has guided every step of this restoration effort. Presenting the assembled rod to her not only confirms that the rod's magic has been restored, but also allows the Sentinel defenders to take the next critical steps in defending their besieged homeland.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this stage of the quest?
faq.answer: Having successfully assembled the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine, you simply need to take the finished rod back to the dryad Shael'dryn, who waits at the moonwell in northern Ashenvale.

Shael'dryn is a dryad tending a sacred moonwell in Ashenvale. Working to cleanse the ancient forest of spreading corruption, she directs trusted allies to gather relics, purify components, and restore sacred artifacts.
Shael'dryn resides at a quiet moonwell nestled in northern Ashenvale, east of the main road leading between Astranaar and Felwood, surrounded by the tranquil waters she watches over.

faq.q: What is the Rod of Transformation?
faq.answer: The rod is Dartol's magical creation. Its restored power is intended to help Raene investigate the furbolgs; what form it grants is discovered later.

faq.q: Why is assembling the rod so important to Astranaar?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner hopes the rod will let an investigator approach the furbolgs and learn more about the attacks threatening Astranaar.

faq.q: Does assembling the rod end the cleansing chain?
faq.answer: No. Shael'dryn next asks you to return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with news that the rod is finished.

angles.text: Restoring the rod helps Raene investigate the furbolg attacks threatening Astranaar and the surrounding groves.
Securing Ashenvale is crucial for the Alliance's standing in northern Kalimdor, safeguarding Astranaar against relentless attacks by local corruption and hostile forces.
Assisting Shael'dryn restores a magical relic needed for Raene's investigation in Ashenvale.
